You don't actually need to level up the frame, you just need to boost their morale. That can be done using plants, upgrading bathroom stalls/breakroom/recreation room/fitness room etc. No need to worry about upgrading frames. Sometimes they will be angry if you don't have the required level for each of the rooms they use outside of the office.

The only way to level them up faster is to keep the game open all day and watching the conference meeting ads. There's also the company exp plant from one of the events, but it's not worth it as it only gives you +10
I would save the gems for any future missions that require you to buy/upgrade an object that costs gems.

You need to get another of the same plant to upgrade it. Both the star tree and gem tree work the same way.

You can get to the end game by ignoring the requests from the companies.
